## Summary

Describe the change and why it matters.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] Manual CLI smoke, if behavior changed
- [ ] Docs updated, if behavior or security posture changed

## Security And Receipts

- [ ] This change does not introduce a new secret, credential, token, or private path.
- [ ] Security-sensitive behavior is covered by tests or explicitly documented.
- [ ] Receipt, policy, sandbox, adapter, or approval behavior is described truthfully.

## Launch Notes

- [ ] Public-facing wording avoids claiming hard OS isolation, universal secret brokering, or hosted multi-user control unless implemented.
